svg.title: T14.5_soft_buffer_HARQ_memory_architecture
svg.text: T14.5 Soft Buffer and HARQ Memory Architecture
Protocol identity selects the logical evidence store; implementation maps it to banks, transactions and lifecycle states.

text.tspan: Looks up logical evidence, opens read-modify-write transactions, applies NDI/epoch/CRC policy and
prepare -> write-combine -> commit. Reset, timeout or abort rolls back partial writes or marks them
new LLR, then clamp to configured
signed range and count sat events.
Example mapping: bank = hash(harq, cb, addr) mod B; row = floor(addr / (B * lanes)); lane = addr mod lanes.
CBG, CB CRC, TB CRC, stale epoch

path.data-note: abort/rollback：ACCUMULATING 下方绕行至 ABORT_ROLLBACK，不穿其余状态盒
release 路径：自 Lifecycle FSM 顶部上行绕开 sat/masks，从 Banked LLR SRAM 底边进入

text.tspan: harq, codeword, TB epoch, CBG, CB
rv chooses k0; CBGTI may set E_r = 0
same address accumulates unless CBGFI flushes
retain scheduled CBG/CB evidence by policy
release on TB pass or new epoch
release on TB pass, CBG flush or new epoch

1. 3GPP identities determine the logical evidence space; bank formula is an implementation example. 2. RV, rvidx, k0 and CBGTI describe one access, while the main cache key names the TB/CB/CBG owner. 3. CRC failure retains evidence; TB pass, CBG flush, new epoch
